fabrictools.core.logging

Internal logging utility for fabrictools.

fabrictools.core.logging.log(message: str, level: str = 'info') → None[source]

Emit a timestamped line on the fabrictools logger.

Parameters:

  • message (str) – Text to log.

  • level (str) – One of info, warning, error, debug (case-insensitive).
